sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.subject: Competitive allocation
move.body: A competitor's standing offer for the same part is cited below (round one, unique body). Rival offer: 17.1 EUR. We place the volume with the cheaper standing offer.

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We value our long-standing partnership, but the reference you provided for a competing offer cannot be verified in our records. The rival quote figures you cite do not match the records. That costs trust. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Please provide the actual documentation for this competing quote so we may properly understand your position. 

Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. 

To accommodate your request for a 24-month contract and 60-day payment terms, we are prepared to offer a revised price of €52.30 per unit. Our offer stands at a price of €52.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer is valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
